clinicalAttribute.description: Numeric value to express the degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation and aggressiveness.
MSI Score reported by MANTIS. The suggested thresholds are MSI: >0.6, Indeterminate: 0.4-0.6 and MSS: <0.4.
MSI Score reported by MSIsensor. The suggested thresholds are MSI: >10, Indeterminate: 4-10 and MSS: <10.
The type of sample (i.e., normal, primary, met, recurrence).
The sum of unbalanced somatic chromosomal breaks per tumor sample (Lakbir et al., Eur J Cancer 2022; Data from new manuscript in progress)
